# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:** When the Divine established and ordered the discrete degrees of the regener ating mind , He arranged each degree so that it dep ended upon the degree above it, and all were held within yet another , in most degree. The first and lowest degree comprises the five ruling ev ils of the prop rium — both false persu asions belonging to the understanding and evil desires belonging to the will.

** ¶3:** This is why each degree of spiritual order was made dependent upon the one above it: the five ruling ev ils were made subordin ate to five divine truths radi ating from the Divine Human — tru ths that proceed from the Lord as celest ial Man — because all the host ility of hell is entwined within these ev ils and can only be restrained by being held bound within the contain ment of those corresponding truths.

**¶4 :** Within a still more interior degree d well five powers of divine good proce eding from the Lord's living love, because the entire structure of the regenerate life is suspended from these goods , depending wholly upon them. *( The damaged text appears to say that these divine goods sust ain still others after them — that is, they flow into and up hold every subordin ate faculty in succession .)*

**¶5:** *(Much of this passage is lost .) * What can be disc erned is this : there is One who came forth into the interior rational — the firm ament that separates the celestial from the natural — and who gov erns all degrees from within a single in most state . This is the sovereign Divine Good itself , dwelling at the centre of the whole spiritual person , ruling the entire created order of the mind from its deep est interior .

---

*Note : * The " five - and -five " structure res ists fully precise translation. In correspondence it points to a complete set of genera — five essential ev ils perfectly matched and held by five essential divine truths — but which specific five Swedenborg would identify ( self -love, world ly love, sens ual fals ity, etc .) cannot be fixed from this passage alone.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of Darkness, males and females.
This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of Darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.

And this is the one who came to [establish and uphold the fi]rmaments above [and below,] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists and reigns] within the [inmost centre] of the universe.

Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living ] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [ hung upon them. And he he] ard (?) him too, the oth[ers who come] after them.
